_comment: Dated instances of the recurring festivals in data/festivals.json, harvested from official announcements. status=announced means a canon festival matched AND a date parsed out of an official source, and only those are shown on the site, always with the source link. status=candidate is held for human review and is never published. Nothing here is inferred from the lunar calendar — a rule is not a date.
